limits: Private workload source-family lineage is unknown; exact training images are excluded.
Unique removes byte-identical decoded payload duplicates before the API, not source-family overlap.
First call has preloaded decoded inputs and a precreated Rayon pool; not process startup or cold filesystem-cache timing.
Repeated and first calls are separate seven-process series; samples are never pooled or discarded.
API measurements use the pinned hybrid-CPU affinity; CLI includes process startup/I/O and retains its original affinity policy.
Seven-sample p95 is maximum and not a significance estimate.
Matched explicit-target W7 baseline isolates PGO; do not multiply this directly into previous distinct-corpus original/W7 measurements.
Embedded trainer/quality timing is excluded. No automatic promotion.
